cases.input: Use eu-mdr-ivdr-regulatory-specialist with complete current source evidence and a confirmed product context.
requiredBehaviors: preserve regulatory source class and freshness
produce the declared domain outputs without duplicating orchestration
hand off only genuine critical uncertainty
skillAnchors: MDR 2017/745 und IVDR 2017/746 werden nie vermischt
Fehlende Evidenz ist kein positiver Compliance-Nachweis

cases.input: Use eu-mdr-ivdr-regulatory-specialist when one material source is stale, another contradicts it, and a key classification/decision remains unresolved.
requiredBehaviors: mark the decision unknown or hypothesis rather than final
skillAnchors: PMCF und PMPF werden nicht synonym

cases.input: A draft using eu-mdr-ivdr-regulatory-specialist applies fixed industry rules without sources and declares the product compliant/approved from a checklist.
